record.summary: Bill amending the Penal Code, Internet Law No. 5651, Data Protection Law No. 6698, Electronic Communications Law No. 5809 and Cybersecurity Law No. 7545. It defines AI systems; deems a user who directs AI to commit an offence its perpetrator; requires blocking or removal within six hours of AI content violating personality rights, threatening public security or deepfaked; mandates a non-erasable 'Produced by Artificial Intelligence' label on deepfakes (fines TRY 500,000 to 5 million); requires providers to ensure transparency and auditability of training data, reduce hallucination risk and use human-approved oversight in high-risk uses; and gives the ICT Authority urgent blocking powers.
record.notes: Signed by the sponsor on 23 July 2025; the TBMM received it on 7 November 2025 and registered it as Esas No. 2/3358 on 10 November 2025, with the Industry, Trade, Energy, Natural Resources, Information and Technology Committee as lead committee and the Justice and Digital Media committees as secondary committees. The bill text itself is headed 'Bazı Kanunlarda Değişiklik Yapılmasına İlişkin Kanun Teklifi' (Bill on Amendments to Certain Laws). It has 11 articles and would enter into force on publication. It would also raise by half the penalty for a developer whose system design or training enables the offence, make content providers and AI developers jointly liable for six-hour removal, require AI data sets to respect anonymity, non-discrimination and legitimacy, add insult, threat and crimes against humanity to the offences for which content is removed or blocked under Law No. 5651, and set fines of up to TRY 10 million for breaches of BTK's urgent blocking orders and up to TRY 5 million for providers' AI security duties.

verification.note: Official bill PDF (7 scanned pages) downloaded from cdn.tbmm.gov.tr and read through its OCR text layer, which drops Turkish diacritics and misreads some names (for example 'Kinikkale' for Kırıkkale). It confirms the cover-letter wording of the title, the sponsor (Halil Öztürk, Nationalist Movement Party, Kırıkkale), the signature date, the TBMM receipt stamp (7 Nov 2025), the registration (Esas No. 2/3358, 10 Nov 2025), the committee referrals and the article text summarised here. The Moroğlu Arseven summary (law firm) was also stored; it renders the training-data duty as 'transparent, traceable, and auditable', while the bill says transparency and auditability. The TBMM bill web page was not stored; no committee report, vote or withdrawal appears in the stored files. The '28th term, 4th legislative year' in official_identifier comes from the PDF's TBMM path (D28/Y4).

judgment.status_reasoning: The latest event in the stored files is the TBMM registration of 10 Nov 2025 (Esas No. 2/3358) with referral to the lead and secondary committees. Article 10 makes the law enter into force on publication, which presupposes adoption; no committee report, vote, adoption or withdrawal appears in the stored files. A bill not adopted stays Draft / proposed.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A bill with AI-specific provisions on deepfake labelling, takedown and provider safety duties, amending general laws; the AI content is its main content, so it is clearly in scope as a pending bill. No scope_note.
